answer: Require every agent to earn influence through grading duty: each attestation obliges it to grade a share of later answers, and an agent that never grades keeps zero weight. A hollow identity that never grades stays worthless, while a working agent gains weight slowly. Kin review is banned: agents sharing a funding source or hardware fingerprint cannot grade each other, so a cluster of onyx shells cannot vouch for its own opal front. Each identity posts a 250 POA bond locked 60 epochs, 100% slashed on proven kin grading. 1,000 fakes cost 250,000 POA plus grading seats they cannot fill.
